integrity: The proof combines an explicit cusp ideal/contact classification with a stated published general substitution theorem. Finite-field tests are corroboration only. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary A2 cusp y^2=x^3 with an added fat x-axis x^u; no claim for other Puiseux pairs or independent thickening of a second branch.
Identity in the Grothendieck ring of reduced punctual Hilbert varieties; no assertion of reduced or smooth scheme structure in the nonreduced cases.
Uses the published arbitrary-germ branch-modification formula (Corollary 6.8 of arXiv:2610.34676v1).
Historical priority is based on examined accessible sources, not exhaustive independent validation.
title: Contact-refined punctual Hilbert series of the cusp and every added fat line
